name: City Council Meeting - Jul 30, 2024
agenda_text:
TORRANCE CITY COUNCIL AGENDA
  JULY 30, 2024
  REGULAR MEETING
  5:00 P.M. - CLOSED SESSION
  IN THE WEST ANNEX COMMISSION MEETING ROOM AT 3031Torrance Bl.

  CITY COUNCIL MAY TAKE ACTION ON ANY ITEM LISTED ON THE AGENDA

City Council Agenda 07-30-24

1.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER

  ROLL CALL
  : Councilmembers Gerson, Kaji, Kalani, Lewis, Mattucci, Sheikh, and Mayor Chen

2.  NON-SECTARIAN INVOCATION: Councilmember Kalani

  FLAG SALUTE: Councilmember Kaji

3.  COUNCIL COMMITTEE MEETINGS AND ANNOUNCEMENTS
  3 - AFFIDAVIT

4.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS (LIMITED UP TO A 15 MINUTE PERIOD) This portion of the
  meeting is reserved for comments on items that are not on the agenda. Under the
  Ralph M. Brown Act, City Council cannot act on items raised during public comment,
  but may respond briefly to statements made or questions posed; request clarification;
  or refer the item to staff. Time starts when you step up to the microphone. If
  presenting handout material to Council, please provide 11 copies to the City Clerk
  before speaking. Handouts to be distributed while you speak.

5.  CLOSED SESSION

  5A. CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL – EXISTING LITIGATION (California
  Government Code §54956.9(d)(1)):
  1)  Maria Soto, et al. v. City of Torrance LASC Case No. 22STCV31095
  2)  Blake Williams v. Eve Berg, et al.  LASC Case No. 21TRCV00034

RECESSED TO CLOSED SESSION

RECONVENED IN PUBLIC SESSION

6.  ADJOURNMENT

  6A. Adjournment of City Council meeting to Tuesday, August 13, 2024, at 5:00 p.m.
  for closed session, with regular business commencing at 6:30 p.m. in the LeRoy
  J. Jackson Council Chamber. Tuesday, August 06, 2024 is a Council Dark Night.
  6A - STAFF REPORT
